thread:
mara-marketing: Quick sync — AuroraEdge customer spotlight. Customer interview scheduled Wed 10am PT. They asked we remove PII and redact one contract figure (ARR) before publish. Also want Spanish + German translations for the launch post. Can legal confirm redaction language and embargo?

sam-creative: Got it. Will prepare an asset plan and two draft hero quotes — one anonymized.

josh-seo: Heads up — for search we should keep a non-sensitive metric (percent improvement) but redact absolute $$$. Will map to metadata for SEO.

rajesh-cs: I'll confirm with the customer on the anonymized percent and get written approval during the interview. We should capture the signed quote release form on the call.

ellie-legal: Thanks — can you paste the exact ARR number you want redacted? We need to propose approved phrasing: e.g., "customer-reported ARR (redacted)" or "AR R comparison removed at customer request". Also confirm embargo date.

mara-marketing: They asked to redact the exact ARR. Embargo target: publish Mon 6/8. Need legal sign-off by Fri 6/5. I'll attach the interview agenda in a sec.

lia-translations: We can handle ES/DE localization. Timeline: 48 hours after final copy. Want the final US English copy by Thu EOD to hit Mon publish. Also can do QA on screenshots.

sam-creative: Draft hero quotes: 1) anonymized: "Redwood slashed latency and cut costs for our inference pipelines." 2) contextualized with percent: "we reduced per-token cost by ~42%". Which version do we use?

josh-seo: Use the percent version for the blog body, anonymized for the short social hero and CTAs. Add structured data: schema.org/CaseStudy with anonymized numeric fields.

ellie-legal: Suggested redaction copy: "[ARR redacted at customer request]." For the release: add clause "Customer consents to anonymized performance metrics; all dollar figures removed." I'll drop a release template below:

ellie-legal: ```
Customer Quote Release — Redwood Inference
Customer Name: [REDACTED]
Authorized Signer: [name]
Permissions: Approve anonymized quotes and percent metrics. Deny publication of absolute revenue and contract values.
Signature: ____________________ Date: _____
```

rajesh-cs: I'll request the signer during the call and attach the signed form to this thread.

mara-marketing: Webinar idea: short-case deep dive 30min + 15 Q&A. Invite product + CS rep. Would drive inbound; can we route registrants to AE pool A (enterprise) and tag origin: "aurora-case-webinar"?

ops-bot: Routing rule created: tag=aurora-case-webinar, destination=AE-Pool-A. Confirmation ID: route_89211.

josh-seo: Also want a short benchmark table in the appendix — anonymized baseline vs Redwood. Keep numbers as percents. Lia, flag if localization needs different phrasing.

lia-translations: Noted. German copy prefers passive phrasing for customer quotes; I'll provide two options for review.

sam-creative: I'll mockup a hero image and 1:1 social cut. Need final quote by Thu 9am PT to finish assets.

mara-marketing: Action items: ellie — finalize release template by Thu AM; lia — confirm ES/DE timelines; rajesh — secure signed release on Wed call; sam — deliver creative by Thu 9am; josh — prepare SEO schema. If any blocker, @here. :sparkles:

rajesh-cs: Noted. Customer confirmed signed rep will be on the call.

ellie-legal: I'll post the finalized release doc here by Thu 8am PT.

sam-creative: Will share first mock by Wed EOD for feedback.

mara-marketing: Thanks team — will follow up after interview with raw audio + timecodes for quotable bits.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: interview Wed 10:00 PT — 1 hour before.

mara-marketing: Tiny ask — if the customer insists on more redaction, we default to anonymized percent-only phrasing. Agreed?

josh-seo: Agree. Percent-only keeps SEO value without exposing contract details.

lia-translations: Agree on percent-only as fallback.

ellie-legal: Agreed. I'll include fallback language in the release form.
